subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Grade 5 Mathematics: Decimals, Fraction Operations & Volume
overview: Grade 5 mathematics deepens students' conceptual understanding of place value, arithmetic operations, algebraic thinking, measurement, and geometry through rigorous problem-solving routines.
competencies: Demonstrate computational fluency and conceptual flexibility across grade-level operations.
Apply visual models, tape diagrams, and equations to represent and solve multi-step contextual word problems.
Analyze geometric shapes, measurement units, and spatial relationships.
Construct viable mathematical arguments and critique the reasoning of peers.

modules.title: Place Value and Decimal Operations
modules.description: Understanding decimal place value to thousandths, rounding decimals, and adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing decimals.

topics.title: Multiplicative Patterns in the Decimal System
topics.description: Reasoning about powers of 10 and shifting digits left/right when multiplying/dividing by 10.

topics.title: Reading, Writing, and Comparing Decimals to Thousandths
topics.description: Using base ten numerals, number names, and expanded form with decimals.

topics.title: Decimal Operations (Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division)
topics.description: Computing with decimals using place value models, area models, and standard algorithms.

modules.title: Multi-Digit Whole Number and Fraction Operations
modules.description: Fluency with multi-digit whole number multiplication (standard algorithm), dividing by two-digit divisors, and fraction operations.

topics.title: Multi-Digit Whole Number Multiplication and Division
topics.description: Multiplying large whole numbers and dividing up to 4-digit dividends by 2-digit divisors.

topics.title: Adding and Subtracting Fractions with Unlike Denominators
topics.description: Finding common denominators using equivalent fraction models to solve word problems.

topics.title: Multiplying and Dividing Fractions
topics.description: Interpreting fraction multiplication as scaling (area models) and dividing unit fractions by whole numbers.

modules.title: Volume and Area of Solid Figures
modules.description: Defining volume as an attribute of 3D solid figures, packing with unit cubes, and applying the volume formula: V = l x w x h or V = b x h.

topics.title: Concepts of Volume and Unit Cubes
topics.description: Packing rectangular prisms with cubic units without gaps and counting layers.

topics.title: Volume Formulas for Rectangular Prisms and Composite Solids
topics.description: Applying V = lwh and finding volumes of composite rectangular figures.

modules.title: The Coordinate Plane and Two-Dimensional Geometry
modules.description: Plotting coordinate pairs (x, y) on the first quadrant of the coordinate plane, analyzing numerical patterns, and classifying 2D figures.

topics.title: Coordinate System Foundations and Graphing Points
topics.description: Identifying x-axis, y-axis, origin, and plotting real-world points on coordinate grids.

topics.title: Generating and Graphing Numerical Patterns
topics.description: Comparing two mathematical rules using tables and lines on coordinate graphs.

topics.title: Hierarchical Classification of 2D Shapes
topics.description: Classifying polygons into hierarchies (quadrilaterals, parallelograms, rectangles, rhombi, squares).
